rationale: Replace the exhaustive 628-cell lifecycle Cartesian grid with 70 declared representative timing cells. Keep the entire 252-cell untimed allocation/correctness grid and 324-cell direct borrowed/CDF audit grid. Selection is by affected paths and input boundaries before any supplemental results; no candidate data were used to select or calibrate these cells.

E05_templates.purpose: Under-cap borrowed sequential operation with empty shards
Required compaction after normalization creates spare capacity
No-edge assembly after ordinary large compression
Distinct distribution and capped no-edge assembly

E10_templates.purpose: Empty owned vector with large spare capacity
Single ordinary owned digest requiring final compaction
Tiny live first input with trailing empty and moderate slack
Large empty first allocation before a full compact live digest
Full-size forty-input merge with large first-input slack

axis_coverage.precision: Every timing template runs f32 and f64.
axis_coverage.lifecycle: Every E10 template runs owned return, owned result drop, and caller-held seed clone plus merge plus result drop. Original seed destruction remains outside the clone-reset clock.
axis_coverage.E05_operations: Build and sequential borrowed forty-input merges both run; the exact same data/operation is used in baseline and candidate.
axis_coverage.E05_input_size: Empty, singleton, under-cap32, ordinary1000, normalization65536 and large100000 boundaries are represented.
axis_coverage.E05_policy: Off, delta300, Use and protected edges each appear with their relevant affected/control operation.
axis_coverage.E10_fan_in: 0,1,2,40 all represented; pair and forty-input ordinary compact merges are explicit.
axis_coverage.E10_capacity: len,16x,65536 all represented through the reachable public builder without fixture cloning before owned timing.
axis_coverage.E10_selected_interactions: Empty plus maximum slack; singleton plus compact capacity; one-input ordinary plus maximum slack; two-input tiny plus trailing empties and moderate slack; two-input leading empty plus maximum slack; compact ordinary pairs and forty-way merges; full-size forty-way plus maximum slack. This is targeted interaction coverage, not a claim of complete pairwise coverage across all axes.
axis_coverage.quality_and_storage: All 252 allocation cells retain five fresh-process repetitions per arm, exact output bytes/query bits, centroid capacity, retained requested and usable bytes, observed allocation counts and allocation-boundary peaks. Timing subset does not shrink storage coverage.
axis_coverage.unchanged_query_controls: Existing frozen v3 p50/CDF/encode/decode controls remain required. They are not duplicated in this lifecycle supplement.

omitted_timing_claims: No general timing claim for every input-size, distribution, policy, capacity, layout or fan-in Cartesian combination.
E05 exact-two-tie normalization and additional tiny sizes remain in allocation/correctness controls only.
Additional matched compact/slack combinations and empty layouts beyond listed E10 templates remain in allocation/correctness controls only.
E10 structural inputs are deterministic ownership/storage controls; changing the seed does not turn them into independent random data. Fresh random v3 confirmation remains necessary.
No allocator-internal transient peak, arena footprint or RSS claim; reported peaks are observed live-object bytes at allocation boundaries in instrumented builds.
execution_estimate: 70 cells x 8 retained-process calls x 7 x approximately60ms timed batches is approximately235seconds of timed work per phase, before pilots, startup and untimed fixture construction. Expect roughly10-30minutes per phase, with small empty/slack fixtures potentially more expensive to reset than to execute. Full allocations add2520 fresh-process calls; direct audits add648. Compile and smoke validation are a separately scheduled first batch. No 10x repeat unless the frozen short-batch rule triggers; root must schedule it separately.
